claims.claim_text: The UK Government's Sovereign AI Venture Fund and the British Business Bank have backed Fractile, a London and Bristol startup developing advanced AI chips, as part of a round worth over £500 million.
claims.excerpt: has secured backing from the UK Government’s Sovereign AI Venture Fund and the British Business Bank as part of a round worth over £500 million.

claims.claim_text: The government says Fractile's current funding round values the company at over £5 billion.
claims.excerpt: Today’s funding round values the company at over £5 billion.

claims.claim_text: The government says Fractile is being backed in its Series C round by investors including CapitalG, Lightspeed and Redpoint.
claims.excerpt: it is also being backed through this Series C round by investors including CapitalG, Lightspeed and Redpoint.

claims.claim_text: Fractile says its approach re-invents AI hardware to be faster, more energy efficient, and less costly.
claims.excerpt: Fractile is re-inventing the hardware that AI runs on, so that it is faster, more energy efficient, and less costly.

claims.claim_text: The Business Secretary says Fractile plans to expand its presence in Bristol.
claims.excerpt: With plans to expand their presence in Bristol

claims.claim_text: The government says typical Sovereign AI Fund equity investments are worth around £1-10 million.
claims.excerpt: Typical equity investments will be worth around £1-10 million, though every company’s circumstances will be different.

claims.claim_text: The government says the Chancellor confirmed a further £140 million backing for Sovereign AI at the recent Budget.
claims.excerpt: the Chancellor confirmed a further £140 million backing for Sovereign AI

claims.claim_text: The government says Sovereign AI will expand into a new focus area of Physical and Industrial AI.
claims.excerpt: Sovereign AI would expand into a new focus area of Physical and Industrial AI
